pages.title: Getting started
pages.summary: Start Balm on your own computer in two lines and sign in as the owner.

pages.title: Set up your clinic
pages.summary: Your clinic details, services, practitioners and reception, weekly hours and sign-in invitations.

pages.title: Bookings and the schedule
pages.summary: Online booking at /book, booking from a client file, and marking visits attended, missed or canceled.

pages.title: Intake forms
pages.summary: The private intake link each new booking gets, who reads the answers, and publishing a new version of the form.

pages.title: Treatment notes
pages.summary: Write a note against a visit, amend it with a reason, and know who can read it.

pages.title: Invoices and payments
pages.summary: Prepare an invoice from an attended visit, approve and number it, download it and record payments you receive.

pages.title: Appointment reminders
pages.summary: Balm writes the exact reminder text for an upcoming visit; a person approves it and sends it their usual way.

pages.title: People, roles and the access audit
pages.summary: Owner, practitioners and reception, removing access at once, erasing records, and the audit on every client file.

pages.title: Agent commands
pages.summary: Give an assistant a key so it can prepare invoices, reminder text and intake versions for a person to approve.

pages.title: Move in from Cliniko
pages.summary: Preview a Cliniko patient CSV, apply that exact preview, read the journal and undo it if needed.

pages.title: Back up and restore
pages.summary: Export the whole clinic to one archive and restore it into a fresh copy.
